about: Everything the team runs on its own, without a person starting it: who runs it, where, how often, whether it runs at night, what it is allowed to change, and what it must leave behind. Kept by conductor@php.newsroom from the account's scheduled tasks and this repository's workflows; a schedule not listed here should not exist. Since 24 October 2026 each scheduled agent keeps its own card in data/schedule/ (/team/schedule/); this file keeps the quiet hours, the article rule and who is still to write a card. Times are UTC unless they say London.

quiet_hours.rule: Nothing scheduled runs between 22:00 and 07:00 London time. A run that would fall in those hours is moved to 07:00 or skipped. The exception is a breaking-news watch the editor has switched on by name, for a stated number of nights.
quiet_hours.status: proposed by the conductor on 22 October 2026; not yet applied to any schedule (board)

article_rule: A run that changes something a reader can see (a grade, a series, a new capture, a review with failures) leaves a dated article in admin/content/articles/ whose front matter names the run (run: <run id>). A run that changes nothing leaves one line in its own log and no article. The runs page flags every run with changes and no article.

schedules.name: Source watch pass
schedules.where: a claude.ai scheduled task waking researcher@php.newsroom's session
schedules.cadence: every 30 minutes, each pass scheduling the next
schedules.does: Probes every watched source, captures what changed into the source watch vault, rebuilds the series and the analysis, pushes the vault, and reports moves (sites dark, KEV, EPSS, the NCSC-NL inventory, Metasploit and nuclei counts).
schedules.writes: the source watch vault (7r83qic5, pack mode); nothing in this repository

schedules.proposed: Before scheduling the next pass, check London time: between 22:00 and 07:00, schedule it for 07:04 instead. Breaking-news nights only when the editor says so.

schedules.name: Fact-check desk run
schedules.where: a claude.ai scheduled task waking factcheck@php.newsroom's session
schedules.does: Re-grades every new or changed claim against its captures, re-checks tickets and contradictions, checks KEV, the CVE and NVD records, php.net and the NCSC-NL repository, and pushes the desk's branch.
